title: Review: kithctl, kith-peer, kith-attach
notes:
Maintainer risk: MEDIUM — P0 bugs in kithctl watch (spurious notifications, bootstrap state fallback, chunked TE) are user-visible on every kithctl watch invocation. The chunked TE issue means JMAP calls silently fail every time. kith-peer and kith-attach are well-structured with good test coverage.
Confidence: 20% chance of missed bug. Uncertainty driven by: (1) cannot verify how kithd actually sends HTTP responses — if it sends HTTP/1.1 with chunked TE the jmap_post issue is a P0 that breaks watch entirely; (2) outbox_tick test coverage is thorough but integration tests against a real kithd network path do not exist; (3) kith-attach is only tested with sync-style byte slices, not with real axum Body streams from HTTP. Would raise confidence if: running kithctl watch against a live kithd and observing actual notification behavior; checking kithd's axum response headers to confirm whether chunked TE is used.
